hello.lisp.description: Editable Unicode text and button callbacks with copied event payloads. Close the frame to exit.

layout.lisp.description: Nested panel rows and columns with spacing and alignment. Close the frame to exit.

form.lisp.description: Run the representative form with text, checkbox and choice updates. Close the frame to exit.

form-app.lisp.description: Reusable form implementation; load it then call WXLAMBDA-FORM:START. The form.lisp launcher does this automatically.

live.lisp.description: Enter the cooperative application REPL with window replacement and live callback redefinition. Use (wxlambda:stop) or EOF to exit.

window-state.lisp.description: Toggle text visibility and input using actual button callbacks. The reusable exercise runs the same callbacks without waiting for manual input.

window-metadata.lisp.description: Direct MAKE-INSTANCE construction of a FRAME subclass. A generic SETF AFTER method counts title changes while a button callback updates the logical name and Unicode title; the exercise verifies state, method dispatch and cleanup.

gauge.lisp.description: A GAUGE subclass with default initargs and a custom step slot; buttons advance determinate progress or request indeterminate pulsing. The exercise runs both callbacks and cleans up.

application-events.lisp.description: The same button callback reports native main-loop state when dispatched through the pending wx event queue and through RUN. The reusable exercise asserts both modes and cleans up handlers/windows.

event-handlers.lisp.description: A standalone EVENT-HANDLER subclass reads native state in an AFTER hook. Separate window callbacks toggle event-handler processing without disabling window input. The exercise verifies queued callback gating and explicit owned-handler cleanup.

event-bindings.lisp.description: Two independent ID-filtered command observers receive queued notifications on a standalone handler. A window button queues notifications; the exercise removes one observer without affecting the other and verifies cleanup.

event-contexts.lisp.description: A contextual button binding conditionally forwards commands to a parent observer. A checkbox controls Skip; the reusable exercise checks consumption, forwarding, native-type snapshots and expiration after callback return.

close-events.lisp.description: A contextual close callback vetoes while a checkbox blocks closing, then releases the convenience callback and delegates to native frame closing. The exercise runs real queued-button requests, checks rejection/liveness and accepted closing cleanup.

notify-events.lisp.description: A registered notify event validates a proposed change synchronously before applying it. A checkbox selects Veto or Allow; the reusable exercise verifies blocked and accepted changes, both callback paths and cleanup.

application-handler.lisp.description: Borrow the cached application event-handler view, queue a registered command, verify delivery and release the binding without destroying wxApp.

session-events.lisp.description: Isolated standalone query-end-session policy with logging-off metadata and checked veto. Never dispatches synthetic session events to wxApp or triggers real OS logout/shutdown.

event-metadata.lisp.description: A synthetic close callback changes native CanVeto and timestamp metadata, applies checked veto and verifies the earlier snapshot remains unchanged. No real OS event is generated.

event-routing.lisp.description: Rewrite a child command ID before parent delivery, verifying original and forwarded snapshot IDs and cleaning up bindings/windows.

event-origins.lisp.description: Compare child and parent native origin identities while binding receivers differ; check current/saved native type and release resources.

event-categories.lisp.description: Compare current/saved native category for a synthetic registered command and test USER_INPUT membership; no selective pumping or OS events.

event-tags.lisp.description: Translate a registered command tag in a child callback, then verify payload-preserving parent delivery for synchronous and queued dispatch; clean up all resources.

owned-events.lisp.description: Construct a reusable native message, mutate only a dispatch copy, retain a detached context clone, queue an independent copy and destroy its source before delivery.

pending-events.lisp.description: Compare posted copies, consumed transfer inputs, local synchronous processing and handler-specific pending cancellation using owned events.

handler-chains.lisp.description: Build reciprocal standalone handler links, observe native chain delivery and detach/splice handlers without changing native ownership.

window-handler-stacks.lisp.description: Push managed standalone handlers on a window, compare explicit stack-aware and generic bypass routing, then pop/remove without transferring native ownership.

command-event-payloads.lisp.description: Compare semantic toggle/selection views with raw extra-LONG action metadata, mutate live owned/context payloads and safely detach a registered command origin.

handler-client-data.lisp.description: Attach EQ-preserved Lisp state to a managed handler, read it through callback receiver identity and clear it before cleanup without exposing Lisp/native pointers.

binding-user-data.lisp.description: Associate EQ Lisp state per binding, read it through snapshots/current contexts and preserve active data across unbinding without exposing native pointers.

idle-events.lisp.description: Process a finite work list through native application idle callbacks, bound RequestMore, restore idle policy and dispose the window without inline wake pumping.

menus.lisp.description: Frame-owned menu bar, normal/check/separator items, ID-routed menu callbacks, mutable resource state and hierarchical invalidation. Programmatic exercise; graphical OS menu selection is separate verification.

standard-dialogs.lisp.description: Interactive START opens a native text prompt; EXERCISE within an active session deterministically cancels a real modal loop from native idle. Generic message/file dialogs are demonstrated separately; platform-native backends remain deferred.

message-file-dialogs.lisp.description: Interactive START asks whether to choose a file and prints accepted selection without reading content. Active-session EXERCISE checks message buttons/file mode and cancels actual generic message/file loops from native idle, including a message without visible Cancel. Native OS alerts/panels remain unbound.

document-form.lisp.description: Persistent UTF-8 form with deferred shared Open/Save/Save As/Copy/Paste/close actions via menus, toolbar and portable keyboard IDs; status feedback, first-request coalescing, delivery-time state, save/discard/cancel and scoped close replay. EXERCISE uses a canceled scripted toolbar Save. Clipboard tests isolate system content; native OS panels, physical shortcuts and multiline editing remain outside this example.

clipboard.lisp.description: Interactive START copies/replaces a whole single-line field through the standard text clipboard with best-effort flush; automatic EXERCISE only queries availability and never reads/replaces system clipboard content.

text-editor.lisp.description: Multiline text controls with native selection/replacement/end offsets, append-at-end and user-editability toggle. Bounded EXERCISE replaces Unicode multiline text and checks notifications/read-only state; no document IO or selection clipboard APIs.

notebook.lisp.description: Editor/settings notebook with fixed panel pages, canonical lookup, native silent/notifying selection and contextual navigation veto. Bounded EXERCISE drives selection/veto; physical tab/keyboard interaction remains separate.

list-manager.lisp.description: Unsorted single-selection list manager with Append/Rename/Delete/Clear actions, native selection and activation feedback. Bounded EXERCISE tests silent item edits and selected-index adjustment without physical input.

tree-navigation.lisp.description: Visible-root single-selection managed tree, canonical item views, expand/collapse, native navigation veto and append/delete buttons. Bounded EXERCISE checks token ownership/subtree invalidation without physical input.

splitter-manager.lisp.description: Fixed two-pane in-memory tree/list manager with canonical panes, model-driven navigation and guarded sash observations.

frame-actions.lisp.description: Shared menu/toolbar actions, check-state synchronization, disabled activation and application-owned status fields. START interactive; EXERCISE runs in an active application session.

keyboard-actions.lisp.description: Shared model actions reached by menu, toolbar and frame accelerator IDs; enable/check policy ignores platform-specific native metadata. EXERCISE uses synthetic action commands, separate native tests verify actual key translation.

deferred-actions.lisp.description: Queue shared menu/tool/keyboard requests for choosing a path, copying editor text and confirmed close. START interactive; EXERCISE injects deterministic chooser/clipboard/confirmation functions without touching system clipboard text.

periodic-status.lisp.description: Real native periodic UI timer updates label/status text; Pause/Resume cancels/creates tickets. Active-session EXERCISE self-cancels after two real updates, without system clipboard transfers.

numeric-input.lisp.description: Signed slider/integer spin synchronization through numeric snapshots with silent cross-control writes and range-clamping button. EXERCISE uses explicit notified setters, not hardware interaction.

radio-groups.lisp.description: Explicitly owned fixed radio choices select export format and update feedback. EXERCISE verifies silent and explicit notifying updates; no physical input simulation.

toggle-buttons.lisp.description: Persistent preview option with native toggle-button checked snapshots and feedback; EXERCISE verifies silent/explicit notify behavior without hardware input.

combo-boxes.lisp.description: Choose a fixed destination preset or type a custom value. EXERCISE checks silent/explicit selection and text notifications, UTF-8 and NIL clearing; no physical input simulation.

scrolling-panels.lisp.description: 24-field form in a scrolling viewport with an owner-bound deferred Back to top action. EXERCISE checks extent, native movement and safe return without physical input simulation.

focus-navigation.lisp.description: Keyboard form with a deferred Return to name action. EXERCISE issues focus/traversal requests without simulating physical keys or asserting OS focus identity.

tooltips.lisp.description: Form name guidance with a deferred Toggle guidance action. EXERCISE verifies Unicode text and remove/restore via queued commands without simulating hover or asserting popup presentation.

date-picker.lisp.description: Required due date with leap-day initialization, copied native change snapshots and an owner-bound deferred Reset action. EXERCISE checks explicit-notify label updates and reset without simulating physical date input.

time-picker.lisp.description: Time-of-day start form with native snapshot feedback and an owner-bound deferred Reset action. EXERCISE checks explicit-notify feedback and reset without simulating physical time input or scheduling anything.

search-controls.lisp.description: Native query and Lisp-native list filtering with deferred TEXT/search handling and explicit deferred cancel/clear policy. EXERCISE uses explicit TEXT notification and a Clear filter command; native search/cancel gestures are tested separately without physical input simulation.

activity-indicator.lisp.description: Native busy feedback toggled through owner-bound deferred button commands; EXERCISE checks state/labels, not animation pixels or background work.

record-manager.lisp.description: Cohesive in-memory tree/list record manager with stable IDs, search/category filtering, notebook details, shared menu/tool/key actions, deferred CRUD/dialogs and clipboard adapters. EXERCISE and tests use deterministic prompt/confirm/copy functions without system clipboard transfers.

drawing-monitor.lisp.description: Retained native canvas with bounded geometry, Unicode text/font/RGB/bitmap adapters, activity animation and owner-bound periodic UI updates. EXERCISE self-stops after three real timer ticks, exports PNG and resumes; data is simulated, not background work.

grid.lisp.description: Fixed-shape inventory string grid with native editing, copied Unicode cells/labels and deferred committed-value readback; EXERCISE validates automated model behavior.

webview.lisp.description: Interactive trusted-development HTML/JavaScript WebView with asynchronous script tickets and JSON message bridge; no external network required by deterministic exercise. Known native popup/dialog/upload paths are suppressed; this is not a general security sandbox.

input-events.lisp.description: Native input observer shows key/character/pointer/focus metadata while preserving native text editing through automatic Skip. EXERCISE observes native size delivery; deterministic native fixtures cover payloads/consumption, not physical input or IME.

aui-notebook.lisp.description: General dynamic panel workspace inside a splitter with deferred Add/Delete/Move/Split actions. Programmatic native tab groups preserve page ownership; mouse reorder is limited to one group. No editor abstraction.

styled-text.lisp.description: General native Scintilla text control with copied Unicode text, styling, margins, indicators, markers, grouped undo, multiple selections, autocomplete/call tip and synchronous same-control container styling; no application editor model.

thread-events.lisp.description: Existing GUI receiver gets copied Unicode/NUL payload from an actual SBCL/CCL worker thread; callback delivery remains on the GUI thread. No native worker closures, editor jobs, network or system clipboard transfers.

report-views.lisp.description: Million-row native virtual report using a CLOS OnGetItemText override, checked decorated tree sidebar and deferred activation actions.

image-viewer.lisp.description: Compose native PNG/RGB/alpha/scaling/bitmap/static display and mouse events; pixel inspection behavior is application code.

grid-editing.lisp.description: Owned native grid editor validation/veto, honest Reset/Save/Hide/Disable distinctions, read-only cell attributes and deferred row changes.
